app.speak.label: Ngikhuluma
app.stats.goal: Umgomo wansuku zonke: amaphuzu angu-{done} kwangu-{goal}
app.footer.about: I-Feliglot iyiphrojekthi ye-Felicity. Imisho yamakhosi ibhalwe futhi yahlolwa yi-AI, futhi isalinde ukubuyekezwa ngabakhuluma lezi zilimi njengolimi lwebele — uma kukhona okuzwakala kungalungile, sitshele.
app.home.intro: Izifundo ezimfushane nezijabulisayo eziqala olimini lwakho — hhayi olomunye umuntu. Zwa yonke imisho, uyisho ngokuzwakalayo, bese uyibuyekeza ngaphambi nje kokuthi uyikhohlwe.
app.home.pick.title: Ufuna ukufunda ini?
app.home.pick.body: Setha u-“Ngikhuluma” phezulu futhi yonke incazelo izovela olimini lwakho. Shintsha ikhosi noma nini.
app.home.how.title: Okuncane nsuku zonke kuya kude.
app.home.how.hear.title: Kuzwe
app.home.how.hear.body: Yonke imisho ishiwo ngokuzwakalayo, kaningi ngendlela othanda ngayo.
app.home.how.practise.title: Kuzijwayeze
app.home.how.practise.body: Amakhadi okufunda, bese kuba nemibuzo: khetha, thayipha futhi usho impendulo.
app.home.how.keep.title: Kugcine
app.home.how.keep.body: Amaphuzu, umgomo wansuku zonke nokulandelana kwezinsuku okuhambisana nempilo yakho.
app.home.why.title: Into engatholakali kalula kwenye indawo.
app.home.why.own.title: Funda ngolimi lwakho
app.home.why.own.body: Hhayi isiNgisi kuphela: izincazelo zivela kunoma yiluphi ulimi kwezingu-{n}, ngakho umuntu okhuluma isiHindi angafunda isiJapane ngesiHindi.
app.home.why.speak.title: Khuluma, ungagcini ngokuthepha
app.home.why.speak.body: Yisho umusho ngokuzwakalayo bese i-Feliglot ilalela — ukuzijwayeza ukuphimisa kwangempela, ngqo kusiphequluli sakho.
app.home.why.remember.title: Khumbula unomphela
app.home.why.remember.body: Imisho ibuya ukuze ibuyekezwe ngokohlelo, ngaphambi nje kokuthi uyikhohlwe.
app.home.why.content.title: Imisho engu-{phrases}, izifundo ezingu-{lessons}
app.home.why.content.body: Kusukela ku-sawubona nangiyabonga kuya emahhotela, ezindaweni zokudlela, empilweni nasekuhleleni izinto.
app.home.cta.title: Imizuzu yakho emihlanu yokuqala iqala manje.
app.home.cta.body: Mahhala, akudingeki ubhalise. Vula i-akhawunti kamuva ukuze ugcine inqubekela phambili yakho kuyo yonke idivayisi.
app.languages.title: Zonke izilimi
app.languages.intro: Amakhosi angu-{courses}, ngayinye inemisho efanayo yansuku zonke engu-{phrases} ezifundweni ezimfushane ezingu-{lessons}.
app.picker.placeholder: Sesha — isb. isiNgisi, isiXhosa, isiSuthu, 日本語
app.picker.none: Ayikabikho ikhosi yalolo limi — ezinye ziyeza.
app.course.intro: Imisho yansuku zonke engu-{phrases} ezifundweni ezimfushane ezingu-{lessons}.
app.course.romanized: Yonke imisho ibuye ibhalwe ngezinhlamvu zesiLatini ukuze ukwazi ukuyifunda kusukela ngosuku lokuqala.
app.tagline.ar: Isi-Arabhu sezindaba, sezincwadi nezimpawu — siyaqondakala kulo lonke izwe lama-Arabhu.
app.tagline.ar-gulf: Isi-Arabhu sansuku zonke osizwa eDubai, e-Abu Dhabi nakulo lonke elaseGulf.
app.tagline.ar-eg: Isi-Arabhu saseCairo — nesamafilimu amaningi, uchungechunge nezingoma zesi-Arabhu.
app.offline.title: Awuxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi
app.offline.body: Izifundo owake wazivula zisasebenza. Xhuma futhi ukuze uvule ezintsha.
